description: Category definitions and filter taxonomy for the Pakistan solar inverter database.

active_v1.name: 6-6.9 kW Single-Phase LV Hybrid
notes: 6.0 through 6.9 kW nominal AC products qualify; do not require the manufacturer to market the product as exactly 6 kW.
Different exact model numbers remain separate products even when they share a series or platform.
HV products are retained as future database candidates where identified but are not part of the V1 tier pool.

filter_principle: Filters describe product attributes and do not by themselves determine tier placement or score.
